text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both holding steady near their recent highs with modest overnight gains, suggesting cautious accumulation rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed index remains elevated at 70 (Greed) but ticked down slightly over the past week, indicating sentiment may be plateauing after a strong rally. BTC's dominant 58.3% market share and $57B in daily volume point to a market led by Bitcoin with healthy participation across alts, though the muted gains across smaller caps like BNB suggest traders are rotating toward the majors.
